item.name: EMF Level 5
item.howToConfirm: Hold the EMF Reader near the ghost while it interacts with objects, manifests, or starts a hunt, and watch the meter climb through its lights.
item.confirmTell: The final red light (Level 5) lights up and a high-pitched beep plays. Lower readings on their own do not count.
item.cardSummary: EMF Level 5 is only confirmed when the EMF Reader hits its top red light during ghost activity. Anything below Level 5 is not this evidence.

item.name: Spirit Box
item.howToConfirm: Stand in the room with the ghost present and the lights off, then use the Spirit Box and ask it questions.
item.confirmTell: The ghost replies audibly and/or shows a red caption at the bottom of the screen. A Plushie can force a response when it starts levitating.
item.cardSummary: Spirit Box needs the ghost in the room with lights off. A spoken answer or red on-screen caption confirms it; the Plushie can guarantee a reply.

item.name: Freezing Temperatures
item.howToConfirm: Carry a Thermometer into the ghost's room and let the reading settle, or watch the room for cold visual cues.
item.confirmTell: The Thermometer reads below 0 degrees C / 32 degrees F. Visible breath, floor fog, and frosted windows also count.
item.cardSummary: Freezing Temperatures is confirmed when the Thermometer drops below freezing, or by cold cues like breath, floor fog, and frosted windows.
item.gotcha: A brief dip that rises again quickly is usually not this evidence; do not confuse breath cues with a ghost mist event.

item.name: Ghost Orb
item.howToConfirm: Point a Video Camera at the ghost room, or view the room through the Video Monitor or a teammate's Head-Mounted Camera.
item.confirmTell: A floating orb appears on camera in the ghost room. In Nightmare it drifts to the new room when the ghost room changes.
item.cardSummary: Ghost Orb only shows up on camera. Watch the ghost room through a Video Camera, the Video Monitor, or a Head-Mounted Camera.
item.gotcha: Skinwalkers can fake Ghost Orb, so confirm the other two evidences before locking it in.

item.name: Prints
item.howToConfirm: Shine a Blacklight over doors, windows, walls, and players after the ghost has interacted with objects.
item.confirmTell: Glowing fingerprints or footprints appear under the light. Disturbed salt lines are a reliable place to find them.
item.cardSummary: Prints are revealed with a Blacklight on surfaces the ghost touched. A disturbed salt line is a guaranteed place to check.
item.gotcha: Prints fade after a while, and they fade faster on higher difficulty, so check soon after activity.

item.name: Laser Projector
item.howToConfirm: Place a Laser Projector in the ghost room and watch the laser field, ideally through a Video Camera for clearer detection.
item.confirmTell: The ghost becomes faintly visible as it walks through the laser grid. Lowering Roblox graphics to 1 bar can improve visibility.
item.cardSummary: Laser Projector confirms when the ghost shows up faintly walking through the lasers. A Video Camera and low graphics make it easier to spot.

item.name: Inscription
item.howToConfirm: Place the Spirit Book in the ghost's favorite room and wait, and also watch the walls for markings.
item.confirmTell: Writing appears in the Spirit Book or on walls. If the ghost throws the book outside a hunt, this evidence is disproven.
item.cardSummary: Inscription confirms when the ghost writes in the placed Spirit Book or marks a wall. A book thrown outside a hunt rules it out.

item.name: Wither
item.howToConfirm: Watch the map over time for passive decay, and place a Flower Pot in the ghost's room as a clear indicator.
item.confirmTell: Flowers wilt, metal rusts, and paintings distort. The time before decay starts is random.
item.cardSummary: Wither has no detector. Watch for decay over time, and use a placed Flower Pot whose flowers wilt as a clear sign.
item.gotcha: On the prison map, prisoner NPCs can act as a form of Wither evidence.
